claims.quote: Betta pardalotos is a large paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from the Musi drainage near Palembang, South Sumatra, Indonesia.

Type locality is the Galem River, a tributary within the larger Musi drainage, close to the city of Palembang, Sumatera Selatan (South Sumatra) province, Sumatra, Indonesia, and the species is possibly endemic to the lower Musi basin.
